units.source_text: 那个生灵的声音渐渐静下去了。

en.t: The voice of that spirit gradually fell silent.

units.source_text: 母夫人推想葵姬现在身体好些，便送过一碗汤药来。

en.t: Her mother thought Lady Aoi must now be feeling somewhat better, and sent over a bowl of medicinal broth.

units.source_text: 侍女们扶她坐起来服药，岂知婴儿立刻诞生了。

en.t: The waiting women helped her sit up to take the medicine, but unexpectedly the baby was born at once.
Everyone in the household was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 但移附在替身童子身上的生灵却嫉妒她的安产，大声骚扰起来，因此大家担心落胞之事。

en.t: But the spirit that had moved into the substitute child grew jealous of her safe delivery and began to make a loud disturbance, so everyone worried about the afterbirth.

units.source_text: 想是左大臣夫妇及源氏公子多修法事、立下宏誓大愿之故，落胞之事终于顺利平安。

en.t: Perhaps because the Minister of the Left and his wife, together with Prince Genji, had performed many rites and made great vows, the afterbirth was finally delivered safely and smoothly.

units.source_text: 于是修法事的比叡山住持及诸山高僧俱各欢慰，拭去头上的汗，匆匆告退。

en.t: Then the abbot of Mount Hiei and the eminent monks from the various temples who had conducted the rites were all relieved and pleased; wiping the sweat from their brows, they hurriedly took their leave.

units.source_text: 家中诸人连日尽心看护，俱各困疲，此时方得稍稍休息。

en.t: The people of the household had devoted themselves to nursing her for days and were all exhausted, and only now could they rest a little.

units.source_text: 左大臣夫妇及源氏公子料想今后可保无事，俱各安心了。

en.t: The Minister of the Left and his wife, along with Prince Genji, thought that all would be well from now on, and they were all reassured.

units.source_text: 为感谢神恩，法事重新开始。

en.t: To give thanks for divine favor, the rites began again.

units.source_text: 但上下诸人都悉心照料这可爱的婴儿，对病人不免疏忽了。

en.t: But everyone, high and low, devoted themselves to caring for the lovely baby, and inevitably neglected the patient somewhat.
